title: P&PD - PCS Workshop CY2026
intro: This workshop offers basic administrative, housing, and household goods shipment information for service members relocating to duty stations within the United States (excluding Alaska and Hawaii).

sections.markdown:
Per MCO 1754.10B, attendance is mandatory for all ranks 90 days before the PCS move to ensure service members and families receive the latest updates from subject matter experts.

Registration is REQUIRED- No Walk-ins

*Please note that there is only one ticket needed per family. Do not reserve multiple tickets per family member and do not register more than once. Thank you!*

[**Register on Eventbrite**](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/pcs-workshop-2026-tickets-1969887883688?aff=oddtdtcreator)

REGISTRATION CLOSES 2 DAYS BEFORE THE SCHEDULED CLASS DATE

This class will be in person.

Notification of changes to this class will be via the mail you provide during registration.

Location: Religious and Family Service Center, 3019 Embry Loop, Quantico VA 22134

Parking: Lejeune Hall overflow parking lot - on Catlin Rd. Please do not park in employee parking in the front or rear of the building

For more information, email [mccsquanticoppdregistration@usmc.mil](mailto:mccsquanticoppdregistration@usmc.mil)
